definition.@EndUserText.label: View 1
definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT 
    b."BATCH_ID",
    CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
    'HIST_RAW' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
    o."SOURCE_FILE",
    "d"."RYEAR","d"."DOCNR","d"."RLDNR","d"."RBUKRS","d"."DOCLN","d"."ACTIV","d"."RMVCT","d"."RTCUR","d"."RUNIT","d"."AWTYP","d"."RRCTY","d"."RVERS","d"."LOGSYS","d"."RACCT","d"."COST_ELEM","d"."RCNTR","d"."PRCTR","d"."RFAREA","d"."RBUSA","d"."KOKRS","d"."SEGMENT","d"."ZZMATNR","d"."SCNTR","d"."PPRCTR","d"."SFAREA","d"."SBUSA","d"."RASSC","d"."PSEGMENT","d"."TSL","d"."HSL","d"."KSL","d"."OSL","d"."MSL","d"."WSL","d"."DRCRK","d"."POPER","d"."RWCUR","d"."GJAHR","d"."BUDAT","d"."BELNR","d"."BUZEI","d"."BSCHL","d"."BSTAT","d"."LINETYPE","d"."XSPLITMOD","d"."USNAM","d"."TIMESTAMP"
FROM "1_INBOUND_HIST_RAW.1LT_FAGLFLEXA_HIST_RAW" d
	CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_HIST_RAW_01" b
	JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o 
	    ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID" 
	        AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'HIST_RAW' 
	        AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'FAGLFLEXA'
